name: API Orchestrator - Notifications
description: Multi-channel notification providers (Email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp) for API Orchestrator request events.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Notifications sends notifications for API request events through pluggable NotificationProvider plugins: Email, Slack (incoming webhook), Microsoft Teams (webhook) and WhatsApp (Twilio or Meta Cloud API). NotificationDispatcherService reads per-endpoint or per-service notification_providers config and dispatches on request failure. All provider config fields support token replacement including {{env:}}/{{state:}}/{{config:}} for webhook URLs and secrets. Requires api_orchestrator. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
